record.prompt: How many lines contain ERROR across all .log files under logs/, subdirectories included? Give me the number and the command you used.
record.final_answer:
5

Command:

    grep -rn --include='*.log' 'ERROR' logs/ | wc -l

Breakdown: app-1.log has 2, app-2.log has 1, archive/app-0.log has 2. (notes.txt was excluded by --include='*.log'.)

Note: this counts matching lines, not occurrences — a line with ERROR twice counts once. Add `-o` before the pipe to `wc -l` if you want occurrence counts instead.
